page.notes: Running head: the "HQ" in HQMINIS is printed with a Q-like O, copied as printed. Long s is printed as plain s throughout. Printed "Ifraelitico" was read as "Israelitico" (long s). The "fanĉto" ligature is read as "sancto". Printed "Ioa." and "Apost." kept as abbreviations. The phrase "ut Deus per / cum significet" is printed this way; it looks odd but is as printed.
